readme.run: Segment a 3D T1-weighted brain MRI into labels or tissue fraction maps
notes: Model weights for MindMap-24 (mindmap), MindMap-16 (mindmap-fast), MindSnap-104 (mindsnap)
and GM/WM/CSF tissue fractions are compiled into the bundled @brainchop/core WebAssembly modules.
No network connection or previously populated cache is required.
Choose --model mindmap (default), mindmap-fast, mindsnap, or tissue-fractions.
Add --save-conform for conformed 256^3 1 mm output, --threads N for CPU threads, or --help.
DICOM import and interactive 3D slice viewing use the web app.
Brainchop is research software; inspect segmentations before quantitative analysis.
Please cite Masoud et al. (JOSS 2023) and Fani et al. (arXiv 2025).
